items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: But the night before that Freddie Jenkins and George Raft and I were, we were shooting craps in a after hours place on Central Avenue

ctx.x: So all the chorus girls, we weren't supposed to know anything about this. They got together. They arranged with the Head of the Paramount Studios to cut off a day from twelve o'clock, to cut off all the actors. They built a special bandstand for the band. Sonny Greer was way up high. They had newsreels at the wedding. They employed the Mills Brothers to sing. Ivy Anderson sang, was hired to sing and they had a cake so big, they had a great big huge cake.

And Mae West was there. All of the actors were there. George Raft was there. But the night before that Freddie Jenkins and George Raft and I were, we were shooting craps in a after hours place on Central Avenue and you know, like they were saying, well you better enjoy tonight because you'll be married, you'll be an old married man soon.
And I wasn't supposed to know. But see they kept saying you are going to be an old married man
